newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toshiba to launch DVD player later this year.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba to launch DVD player later this year.

text.p: Toshiba Corp said on Thursday it would launch a digital video disc (DVD) player and other DVD products later this year.
Toshiba will start selling its first DVD player on November 1 in Japan at a price of 77,000 yen, a company spokesman said.
On Thursday, Toshiba started sample shipments of the company's first DVD-read-only memory (ROM) drive for personal computer users, he said. The product's price is set at 90,000 yen in Japan, he said.

Toshiba would also start sample shipments of a DVD decoder board, which is also for computers, from the end of October, the Toshiba spokesman said. The price of the product was set at 150,000 yen, he said.
The decoder is used together with a DVD-ROM when computer users want to watch movies and other software images on their computer monitor, he said.
DVD is a new recording system which has large storage capacity and is expected to eventually make videocassette recorders, compact disc (CD) players and CD-ROMs obsolete.
